children: Kirin completed its acquisition of all Jamieson Wellness shares for C$45.75 per share in cash. The shares are expected to be delisted from the Toronto Stock Exchange shortly.
Kirin acquired all shares for C$45.75 cash each
The acquisition is complete, converting public shareholders' equity into cash consideration and ending Jamieson's standalone public-company status.
Full ownership confirms the change of control; the release provides no prior-period financial comparison.
Trading access is expected to end, subject to the stated timing; remaining shareholders must follow the consideration process.

This completes the previously announced acquisition and confirms the transition of Jamieson Wellness from a publicly traded company to wholly owned subsidiary ownership. The next milestones are the expected TSX delisting and completion of shareholder payment processing.
